_top.start: The single finding most worth verifying first: on 2026-09-13, commit 109053ad failed its CI verification (step 'Unit tests') and GitHub's automatic legacy Pages build deployed that same commit anyway. The capture below is the API read-back taken on 2026-09-14 before anything was changed; VERIFY-COLD.md gives the anonymous API calls and expected values so it can be re-checked without us.
_top.verify: This site is deployed only by the deploy job of .github/workflows/verify.yml, which consumes the artifact the verify job produced and fetches every file back. The per-file SHA-256 manifest of the deployed tree is served at https://mahmood726-cyber.github.io/meta-harness/_production/manifest.json (key files['evidence/<dir>/<file>']). The post-deploy attestation record for each deployment is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mahmood726-cyber/meta-harness/production-records/<full commit sha>.json. Each directory index below also prints the SHA-256 of every capture's committed bytes.

gate-authority-2026-09-14._title: Gate authority (2026-09-14): deploy conditional on verification; server-side rule; one standard
gate-authority-2026-09-14._intro: Before this tranche a commit that failed CI was served (109053ad). These captures show the pre-fix state from the API, the refusals after the fix, and the clean cases.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.01-prefix-deploy-unconditional.txt: PRE-FIX, from the API: verify run 34775559625 on 109053ad FAILED (Unit tests) at 18:44:29Z; the legacy 'pages build and deployment' run 34775558931 on the same SHA SUCCEEDED at 18:44:28Z; main had no branch protection and no rulesets; Pages source was the legacy branch build.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.02-pages-source-switch.txt: The settings change: Pages source switched from the legacy branch build to GitHub Actions, read back as build_type=workflow.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.03-refusal-plant-failing-test-not-deploy: REFUSAL: a deliberately failing test (a74b5c42) pushed to main from a clone with no hooks: verify FAILED, the deploy job was SKIPPED, no deployment exists for that SHA, the served page hash is unchanged.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.04-clean-revert-deployed.txt: CLEAN CASE: the revert (8af8dfb0) pushed from the same hooks-free clone: verify succeeded, deploy succeeded, deployment 6439113037 recorded.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.05-ruleset-created.txt: The server-side rule: ruleset 23314494 on main requiring the verify check, no bypass actors, force-push and deletion blocked; read back active.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.06-refusal-server-rejects-direct-push.tx: REFUSAL: a hooks-free clone pushes an unchecked failing commit straight to main: rejected by the server (GH013, 'Required status check verify is expected'); main unchanged.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.07-refusal-branch-route-red-check.txt: REFUSAL: the same failing SHA pushed to a branch (verify ran and failed) then pushed to main: rejected (GH013, 'verify is failing'); main unchanged.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.08-prefix-hook-lets-failing-test-through: PRE-FIX: with a failing test staged, the old local hook printed 'nothing to gate' and exited 0.
gate-authority-2026-09-14.09-new-standard-refuses-index-and-test-p: REFUSAL (local): the unified standard refuses a hand-edited served index ([REFUSED] index currency) and a staged failing test ([REFUSED] unit tests, hook exit 1).
gate-authority-2026-09-14.10-prefix-old-ci-green-on-hand-edited-in: PRE-FIX in CI: the old workflow went GREEN on a branch whose served docs/index.html was hand-edited.
REFUSAL in CI: the same hand-edit on the new workflow is refused under 'index currency', deploy skipped, and main rejects the SHA.

search-v2-guard-2026-09-15._intro: 5 of 21 sealed MEASUREMENT topics were RAN_ERROR because the engine's anti-name-seeding guard refused a registered vocabulary token that is not a trial name (CABG, BAY94-8862, PCSK9, LCZ696, NSTE-ACS). The rule that replaces the hand-grown allowlist is stated here in full, labelled retrospective, with both answers it yields disclosed before the re-run; the plants show the detector still fires.
search-v2-guard-2026-09-15.PROTOCOL.md: The rule (sealed-vocabulary exemption + benchmark-acronym collision), what was observed, both answers disclosed, what the rule does not do, and the four plants P1-P4. RETROSPECTIVE: authored after the RAN_ERROR outcome was known.
search-v2-guard-2026-09-15.01-plants-pre-fix.txt: P1-P4 run against the engine as committed at 01e39f2e (blob 3652170), before the rule existed: all 8 plants FIRED with the exact offending token. This is the pre-fix arming proof; a plant that only passes post-fix proves nothing.
search-v2-guard-2026-09-15.02-plants-post-fix-guard-alone.txt: The same 8 plants on the post-rule engine WITHOUT a slug (no seal, no exemption): all 8 still FIRE with the same token -- the guard itself is unchanged; the rule adds an exemption path, it does not loosen the detector.
search-v2-guard-2026-09-15.03-plants-post-fix-sealed-exemption.txt: The post-rule engine WITH the committed seal: P1 fires; P2's FISSH collision is recorded by the sealer (11 of 278 positives resolvable) and the seal row grants no exemption so the guard refuses FISSH by name; P3 (unsealed QZXV-77) fires; P4's five topics are allowed, each exempted token named (CABG; BAY94-8862; PCSK9; ARNI, LCZ696; AZD6140, NSTE-ACS, ST-elevation, ST-segment, STEMI).
